Name: Moli by Lexmount
Tagline: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses
Description: Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

Name: Badgey
Tagline: Your iPhone becomes a name badge that faces the room
Description: Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. On a lanyard, it turns to face the people you meet and swings as you move. In a chest pocket, it shrinks so your name shows above the edge. Several badges, a QR code for your link, five designs.

Name: Openstatus Incident Management
Tagline: Incident management for small teams
Description: Open source incident management next to your monitors and status page. Declare from Slack, get a channel per incident, keep a timeline and draft the postmortem.

Name: AgentGrid.io
Tagline: Shared workspace for humans and agents
Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Maker Tools, Vibe coding
Description: Built for Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, Cursor, Codex, all agents are welcome. Work on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history.

Name: pawl
Tagline: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw
Description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

Name: git-flow-next
Tagline: Your favorite Git workflow. Reimagined.
Topics: Open Source, Software Engineering, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: A flexible, modern approach to the popular git-flow branching model. Download the CLI tool to get started with a better Git workflow: brew install git-flow-next

Name: Llama Windows
Tagline: One local AI server for all your Windows apps
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Development
Description: Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

Name: MRRaudit
Tagline: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust
Description: MRRaudit explains why your MRR numbers differ so you can get to a figure you trust. Compare Stripe and ChartMogul customer by customer, trace discrepancies to invoices and subscription events, and choose how billing events affect MRR. Built by the ChartMogul team, who've obsessed over SaaS metrics since 2014 and helped thousands of SaaS businesses investigate these differences by hand through calls and support tickets. Read-only access. No ChartMogul account required.

Name: Clips by Plastic
Tagline: Lyric video ads for every part of your song, on the beat
Description: Drop in a finished song and your own footage or photos. Clips finds the tempo and every part (verses, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge) and makes a vertical lyric video for each one, cut on the beat, with the words synced. Pick a layout and one of 54 effects, then export every part on every backdrop at once, named and ready for Ads Manager. Run them all for a week and put your budget behind the part that wins. Works offline. Free to try, then $99 once.

Name: Yourcast 2.0
Tagline: AI summaries with tap-to-jump timestamps, right in Telegram
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Audio
Description: Yourcast is a Telegram bot for podcasts: search a show, tap to subscribe, and new episodes arrive as audio right in your chat. 2.0 adds AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that repair themselves, files up to 2 GB, OPML import and payments in Telegram Stars. Free: 10 episodes a week on demand. Open source (GPL v3). In English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Hebrew.

Name: Specsight
Tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
Description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

Name: Papermark Virtual Data Room
Tagline: Secure data rooms your AI agents can run. Live in < 60 sec.
Description: Data Rooms 2.0: launch a secure data room in under 60 seconds. Encrypted, fully certified, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, a full audit log and analytics. White-label it on your domain, or let agents run it via API, CLI and MCP.

Name: How It Spread
Tagline: See how anything went viral, from the first post
Description: A library of 1,000+ viral films, products, memes and campaigns. Each case embeds the original, dates every step from first post to peak, sources every number and scores the spread from data. New breakouts get traced as they spread. Free to browse.

Name: Sunlight Diary
Tagline: AI cheerleader based on daily sunlight target
Description: Meet Sunlight Diary, a personal cheerleader based on daily sunlight target. Our AI agent helps you choose a daily sunlight goal, get a suggested outdoor routine, record your time outside, and check in with how you feel. Louie is your companion along the way. Try it in your phone's browser — no wearable needed.

Name: Stirred Art
Tagline: Strava for bars, Vivino for cocktails
Description: Stirred Art scans your photos, detects bars and drinks, builds your flavour profile based on eleven flavours like bitter, smoky and umami, and then personalises bar menus. Everything works offline, so you can get a ranked menu even in the most speakeasy basement out there. It also shows what you can make at home, remembers what each friend drinks (and what they can't), and turns your photos into a map of the bars and drinks you loved.

Name: Screenodon
Tagline: Nail Your App Store Screenshots
Description: Make your whole App Store and Google Play screenshot set in one sitting: an AI draft from raw screenshots, real device frames, 39 languages and publishing straight to App Store Connect. New: all four iPhone Duo sizes. Try it without an account.

Name: LinkedEmbed
Tagline: LinkedIn Widgets for Websites
Description: LinkedEmbed is a no-code LinkedIn widget builder that lets you embed LinkedIn feeds, posts, profiles, recommendations, company job listings, projects, and certifications on any website. Create beautiful, customizable LinkedIn widgets for WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, and more. Showcase professional social proof, display LinkedIn content, and track widget views, clicks, and engagement. All from one simple dashboard. No coding required.

Name: 2G
Tagline: neural synthesis, but it’s 2002
Description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

Name: Drint
Tagline: Packaging design software: dielines, 3D mockups, print files
Description: Drint is packaging design software in the browser. Pick a structure or a FEFCO / ECMA code, type the size, and design straight on a real dieline while the 3D mockup folds as you draw. Export print-ready CMYK PDF/X-4 with cut and crease lines, plus finishing files for foil, spot UV and embossing. About a thousand ready mockups for boxes, bags, cartons, cans and labels, in 14+ languages. Free to start.

Name: TONAUT
Tagline: Synth, drums, sequencer and 8-track tape for iPhone and iPad
Description: Tonaut is a synth, drum machine, sequencer and eight-track tape for iPhone and iPad, made to be played rather than programmed. 9 synth engines, over 500 sounds, 41 drum kits, a chord pad, 16 effects and an eight-lane sequencer. On iPhone, five housings with key LEDs. $19.99 - one-time purchase for iPhone and iPad. No subscription, no account. AUv3 is coming in 2.0, free.
